standard_prerequisites.name: Node of a condition, validity and the set pi of a node
standard_prerequisites.statement: A (sigma, a)-node is an M-finite sequence of pairs (i_s, rho_s) with each rho_s a non-empty M-finite R-transitive subset of X_a, increasing in the order of the integers and comparable in the direction prescribed by the bit i_s; it is valid when every block is contained in the corresponding side A_{i_s}(R) of the colouring; pi of the node is the union of sigma with all blocks; the author's own definition is retained at source lines 819-829.
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the objects of the counted lemma, namely a valid node and its union pi, whose transitivity is what makes the pair (pi, b) a condition.

standard_prerequisites.name: Stability of the colouring R and the collection scheme
standard_prerequisites.statement: Stability of R means that for every x in X_a the set of y above x on which R holds is either finite or cofinite, which turns the validity of a node into infinitary comparability statements; the collection scheme for Sigma^0_2 formulas then lets the finitely many bounds obtained that way be taken uniformly.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof converts validity into the statements that each block is below or above almost all of X_a, and then uses collection to find a single initial segment whose removal makes the comparisons uniform.

standard_prerequisites.name: The set attached to a node is transitive
standard_prerequisites.statement: For every node the union of sigma with all its blocks is R-transitive; this is the statement of the immediately preceding lemma, retained with this card at source lines 831-833.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof invokes it to conclude that the set tau it constructs is R-transitive, which is one of the two conditions for (tau, b) to be an extension of (sigma, a).

core_obligations: Expand the valid node as the sequence of pairs (i_0, rho_0) up to (i_{q-1}, rho_{q-1}) (source line 846).

Translate validity through stability of R: for every rank s below q, if the bit is zero then every element of the block is related to almost all elements of X_a, and if the bit is one then almost all elements of X_a are related to every element of the block (source line 847).

Apply the collection scheme for Sigma^0_2 formulas to the finitely many ranks to obtain a single bound r such that, after deleting the initial segment of X_a of length r, the comparisons become uniform: with the bit zero the block is related to the whole of the remaining set, and with the bit one the whole remaining set is related to the block (source line 848).
Let b be the index with X_b equal to the remaining set and let tau be the union of sigma with all the blocks, so that X_b is contained in X_a (source line 848).

Use the preceding transitivity lemma to see that tau is R-transitive, and use the construction to see that X_b lies inside a minimal interval of tau; the pair (tau, b) is then an extension of the condition (sigma, a), which is the statement of the counted lemma (source lines 849-850).

proof_roadmap.step: Expand the node and rewrite validity as almost-all comparisons using stability of R.
Apply collection to get one bound r, define the remaining set X_b and the union tau.
Invoke the transitivity lemma to conclude that (tau, b) extends (sigma, a).

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 arXiv:2402.11616v3 的 Lemma lem:sem-wf-valid-leaf-force-positive（源 841-844 行，证明 845-850 行）：SEM 力迫中任一有效节点 ν 都能给出底条件的一个扩展 (π(ν), b)。关键操作不是例行核验：作者先把「有效」（每块落在 A_{i_s}(R) 内）通过 R 的稳定性翻译成「块与 X_a 的几乎所有元素可比」的无穷多陈述（847 行），再用 Σ^0_2 收集原则把这有限多个界统一成一个 r，删去长度为 r 的初始段后比较成为一致的（848 行）；最后要同时验证两件事才能断言 (π(ν),b) 是扩展——π(ν) 的 R-传递性（靠前一张卡的引理）与 X_b 落在 τ 的某个极小区间内（靠构造）。难点在于把逐块的几乎处处性质压成统一的界，且两步验证缺一不可；原文位置在证明的 847-849 行。
